short: A temporary holding account for entries you cannot yet classify.
seoTitle: Suspense Account — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A temporary holding account for entries you cannot yet classify. It is meant to be emptied. Suspense is useful for a week and dangerous for a year.
definition: A suspense account temporarily holds transactions that cannot yet be classified — an unidentified bank credit, a difference in the trial balance, a payment with no reference. It is meant to be emptied.
bodyHtml:
Why Suspense Account matters

Suspense is useful for a week and dangerous for a year. Balances left there hide misposted revenue, duplicate payments and genuine errors, and they always surface at the worst moment.

How Suspense Account works in practice

Review the account monthly and clear every item to where it belongs. A persistent balance means someone stopped asking what a transaction actually was.

faq.question: Is a suspense account allowed?
faq.answer: As a temporary working account, yes. Carrying a balance into the financial statements is a problem.

faq.question: What usually ends up in suspense?
faq.answer: Unidentified bank receipts, part-payments without references, and the balancing difference from a one-sided entry.
